columns.text: "Creation eagerly awaits the revealing of the sons of God" Rom 8:19-21

The sons of God, are first mentioned in the Old Testament. Who are these sons of God? Job 38:3-7 Why is creation still waiting for the sons of God? Rom 8:19-21 This is the story of Yahweh’s two families, the heavenly sons of God and the earthly sons of God.

pages.title: God dwells with His Families
pages.description:
The story of what is happening behind the scenes of Creation - from Genesis to Revelation.

Understand passages there were a little strange instead of passing over them.  You will see and understand the bible like you never did before.

As you read this story, the Word of God will open up next to it with a single click or tap.

columns.text: Before everything existed, God wanted to dwell with a human family forever. 1 His plan would take thousands of years to complete because He wanted His family to be fruitful and fill the earth. 2  God already had a spiritual family in heaven and wanted a place where they all could live as one. 2
1 Eph 1:3-5 2 Gen 1:283 Eph 3:14-15

So God created a planet especially suited for both humans and spiritual beings. His heavenly family rejoiced as they watched. 1  The planet was surrounded by myriads of galaxies which could be seen in all directions.  Why did God make so many galaxies?  Because He knew that everyone would look up and see His infinite power and glory. 2  God called the planet earth and filled the land, sea and sky with all kinds of animals.  He provided climates to grow all kinds of beautiful plants and tasty food. 3  Earth was good for His families.
1 Job 38:4-72 Psa 147:4-5 3 Gen 1:21-25

After creating a suitable home for His human family, God (named Yahweh), created Adam.  The first human being was also created as a son of God, just like the heavenly beings who had rejoiced at creation were sons of God. 1  Yahweh is God and Father 2 of whom He created. 3  Yahweh created all of mankind through Adam and Eve.  He created them male and female so that they would multiply and fill the earth and become His human family. 4  God placed mankind in the garden of Eden where He would be with them. 289  All that He had made was 'very good'. 5 He made mankind in the image and likeness of His heavenly realm; They were to reign on earth, according to God's ways. 6 Yahweh's plan was, and still is, to dwell with His human family on earth, forever.
1 Luk 3:38 2 Eph 4:6 3 Mal 2:10 4 Gen 1:27-28 5 Gen 1:31 6 Gen 1:26

headings.name: Beliefs - The Human Race returns to Eden

columns.text:
Yahweh promised that Human Beings will eventually return to a restored creation - Eden.

Jesus will return and the earth will become the paradise He planned from the beginning.

Humans are created in God’s image and one day live and walk in all of God's ways.
Meditate on Gen 1:27-28 and Gen 2:15 and notice: image, dominion, fruitful and multiply. Notice God's plan for the human race is in Eden - Paradise. 1  2
1 Gen 1:27-28 2 Gen 2:15
We are to take Jesus' obedient life as our model because He is the Word of God made flesh and the Way, the Truth and the Life. 1  2
1 Jhn 14:6 2 Mat 5:16
Ask: "Where or when am I tempted to reign without God, or to refuse the good work He has given me?" Determine to be made into the image of God in that situation. 1  2
1 Eph 2:8-10 2 Jhn 1:14
When reading the bible, recognise all the verses that not only teach about today but also teach about the future. Both are important because both are in the bible for a reason.

columns.title: Why did God create the universe?
columns.text: God wanted mankind to recognise His power over all creation and His love for the world. :::details 1. God demonstrates His infinite power to all mankind every day.  2. No one has an excuse for not acknowledging God and being grateful for His creation and for being created in the first place. Psa 19:1-4 Rom 1:20-21

columns.title: Why did God create mankind?
columns.text: God wants mankind to know Him so that He can dwell with His human family forever. :::details God wants mankind to know that He is Yahweh, God Almighty.  He loves the world and gave His only begotten Son that they might have eternal life with Him. Jer 24:7 Jhn 3:16-17

pages.title: Mankind is tempted to sin - Eden

columns.text: :::p:2: Yahweh had given mankind freedom to: :::p:2: 1. follow Him :::p:2: 2. follow their own desires :::p:7: 3. follow others :::p:7: He knew that mankind would refuse to follow in all His ways and some would follow others and become wicked with great evil in all their thoughts. Left to their own devises, they would destroy everything that was good. :::p:7: Despite knowing this, He was determined to give mankind the option to reject being part of His family. To prevent all those who sin, from living forever,  God denied temporary access to the tree of life. The wicked who both rebel and refuse to follow God and His ways, are destined for eternal separation from Him and His family. 1   Any sin, no matter how small, is not allowed in God's presence, for the sake of eternal life with His family. However, He had already planned that a descendant of Eve would make a way for mankind to live with Him. That promise is true — and eternal. 2
1 2Th 1:6-9 2 Jhn 3:16-17

Yahweh told Adam and Eve they could eat from every tree of the garden but one. Eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and in that day you die.

Then a serpent came with a different word. He asked if God had really said that, and promised they would not die — they would be like God. The woman looked at the tree.
1 Gen 3:22-24

Adam and Eve were commanded by God to multiply and fill the earth. He also told Eve that He would greatly increase her conception. Considering that the average age of Adam and 8 of his descendants was 912 years, there would have been an enormous population by the time of the flood. 1  2  3
1 Gen 1:28 2 Gen 3:16 3 Gen 6:1

Adam and Eve left Eden knowing Yahweh and both good and evil. Some of their descendants also knew Yahweh but in the end Noah was the only righteous man left on earth. The earth itself became corrupt because mankind was so corrupted. 1  2  3
1 Gen 3:22 2 Gen 6:5 3 Gen 6:9-12

headings.name: How did Mankind become so corrupt?

columns.text: Genesis 6 says: • men began to multiply on the face of the earth • daughters were born to men • the sons of God saw the daughters of men and they took wives for themselves of all whom they chose • Yahweh said, "My Spirit shall not strive with man forever • There were giants on the earth in those days when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men and they bore children to them • Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intent of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually. 1
1 Gen 6:1-5

columns.title: How did the sons of God produced giants with the daughters of men?
columns.text: The daughters of men were descendants of Adam - human beings. Who were the sons of God?

columns.title: What is about the sons of God choosing daughters of men as their wives that Yahweh had a problem with?
What is so unique about the great wickedness that God saw?

headings.name: Who were the sons of God?

columns.title: Option 1: The sons of God are sons of Adam
columns.text:
The genetics from Adam included genes that produced giants.

1. If it was natural genetics, why did Yahweh have such a problem with men taking wives?

2. Why would Yahweh blame men for doing what was both natural and commanded?

3. Where were there not more giants after the flood if it was in the genes?

4. Where did the great wickedness come from?

5. Why use the phrase sons of God for the husbands and daughters of men/Adam for the wives?

This option sees to create more questions than it answers!

columns.title: Option 2: The sons of God are the elohim with Yahweh
columns.text: Before the flood, the rebellious sons of God led mankind into great wickedness. Deu 10:17 2Pe 2:4-5 The book of Enoch, provides an account of what the sons of God taught before the flood: • making war • potions • lust of the eyes • occult arts All of them are evident since the flood. :::info Enoch 6:1-8:3 The Book of Enoch is an ancient Jewish writing that expands on sections of the Bible. It is not part of the inspired Scriptures (the 66 books of the Bible) but is quoted in the New Testament — Jud 1:14-15 It is useful as historical background for how some Jews understood concepts and phrases, eg the “sons of God/Heaven,” but it does not carry the authority of Scripture. Leading up to the Flood Gen 6:1-8 6.1 And it came to pass, when the sons of men had increased, that in those days there were born to them fair and beautiful daughters. 6.2 And the Angels, the sons of Heaven, saw them and desired them. And they said to one another: "Come, let us choose for ourselves wives, from the children of men, and let us beget, for ourselves, children." The sons of Heaven taught them corrupt ways 7.1 And they took wives for themselves and everyone chose for himself one each. And they began to go into them and were promiscuous with them. And they taught them charms and spells, and they showed them the cutting of roots and trees. 7.2 And they became pregnant and bore large giants. And their height was three thousand cubits. (appears to be an error) 7.3 These devoured all the toil of men; until men were unable to sustain them. 7.4 And the giants turned against them in order to devour men. 7.5 And they began to sin against birds, and against animals, and against reptiles, and against fish, and they devoured one another's flesh, and drank the blood from it. 7.6 Then the Earth complained about the lawless ones. 8.1 And Azazel taught men to make swords, and daggers, and shields, and breastplates. And he showed them the things after these, and the art of making them; bracelets, and ornaments, and the art of making up the eyes, and of beautifying the eyelids, and the most precious stones, and all kinds of coloured dyes. And the world was changed. Corruption led to Destruction 8.2 And there was great impiety, and much fornication, and they went astray, and all their ways became corrupt. 8.3 Amezarak taught all those who cast spells and cut roots, Armaros the release of spells, and Baraqiel astrologers, and Kokabiel portents, and Tamiel taught astrology, and Asradel taught the path of the Moon. 8.4 And at the destruction of men they cried out; and their voices reached Heaven.

The bible names three sons of Adam -- Cain, Abel (murdered by Cain) and Seth.  Cain's line is considered by some to be the faithless seed of the serpent and Seth's line the faithful seed of the Woman. However, 'sons of Cain' and 'sons of Seth' are not biblical terms.

There are other biblical pairings: • sons of God / sons of Adam • the woman / serpent - enmity between them • seed of the woman / the seed of the serpent - crushing the head of the seed of the serpent Gen 3:15

After the flood, the people did multiply but they did not want to fill the earth. They agreed to ignore God’s command and stayed together to make a name for themselves. They decided to build a tower to reach up to the heavens where God and the sons of God were. This was a continuation of the serpent's deception to disobey God and to become like gods (elohim - divine assembly), knowing good and evil. Yahweh responded by dividing them into nations. Gen 3:22 Gen 11:4 Gen 11:8
Yahweh's original command to mankind was to be fruitful, fill the earth and have dominion over it. 1
1 Gen 1:28

After the flood, the people did multiply but they did not want to fill the earth. They agreed to ignore God’s command and stayed together to make a name for themselves. They decided to build a tower to reach up to the heavens where God and the sons of God were. This was a continuation of the serpent's deception to disobey God and to become like gods (elohim - divine assembly), knowing good and evil. Yahweh responded by dividing them into nations. 1  2  3
1 Gen 3:22 2 Gen 11:4 3 Gen 11:8

Before the flood, the rebellious sons of God led mankind into great wickedness and here, at the tower of Babel, mankind was still walking contrary to God.  Just as mankind was divided into nations, the sons of God were divided among them; thereby reducing their influence over any one group. We never saw the same level of pre-flood wickedness across all of mankind again, albeit there are pockets of it still to be found.
And so the nations were ruled by sons of God who still had evil intentions. The people had agreed to rebel against Yahweh and so they would reaped the consequences. 1
1 Deu 32:7-9

headings.name: However, Yahweh also formed a nation for Himself

columns.text: In the Deuteronomy reference above, Yahweh determined to make one nation for Himself. They would be His people and Jacob, also known as Israel, would receive His inheritance. They were to be a nation who would serve Him. 1
1 Act 17:26-27
Immediately after the Tower of Babel rebellion by mankind, Yahweh chooses one man, Abram, later to be renamed Abraham, Father of many nations. 1
1 Jas 2:23
Not only that, but the sons of God who were allocated to them, became their gods and taught them great evil eg child sacrifices. 1
1 Lev 18:21

The fruit of the sons of God before the flood was great wickedness of mankind in the earth. The nations were allocated their territory (inheritance) where they would be free to live how they choose under the gods they had chosen. The nations have worshipped their own 'sons of God' (heavenly beings) as gods. They made images of them as idols. 1
1 Gen 6:4-5

Yahweh gave them over to wickedness until the time to judge them. The last time that He judged the wickedness of the world, they were all destroyed in a flood. This time, He has sent them a Saviour through Israel, but there will be judgement for all those who reject His Saviour. 1  2  3  4  5
1 Gen 6:4 2 Psa 82:1 3 Psa 82:2 4 Psa 82:6-8 5 Nah 1:2-3

pages.title: God creates His own Nation - Israel

columns.text: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God. 1
1 Lev 25:38

After the flood the people multiplied and wanted to make a name for themselves. So they agree to build a tower to reach the heavens, where God was. This was the continuation of the serpent's deception - to be like God by eating the fruit and know good and evil. Yahweh stopped them by dividing them into nations. 1  2  3
1 Gen 3:4-5 2 Gen 11:4 3 Gen 11:8

This dividing into nations was done according to the 'number of the sons of God'; (evil heavenly beings who, before and after the flood, slept with the daughters of men. And so the nations continued to know good and evil rather than following Yahweh. 1  2
1 Deu 32:7-9 2 Gen 3:22
Not only that, but the sons of God who were allocated to them, became their gods and taught them great evil eg child sacrifices. 1
1 Lev 18:21

headings.name: Examples of national gods of the region

columns.text: Every nation worshipped their own gods. Some examples in their anthropomorphic form are: • Apis -- Egyptian sacred bull & Canaanite bull storm god • Ashur / Ahura Mazda -- Near Eastern / Mesopotamian, bearded, winged, lion • Osiris or Amun-Ra - Egyptian pharaoh, god style with serpent headdress • Amun -- Egyptian, air and invisibility often depicted with blue skin • Apollo -- Greco-Roman style or Hellenistic -- Serapis As slaves in Egypt, the children of Israel were worshipping Egyptian idols. 1
1 Ezk 20:6-7

headings.name: Israel are given their own Nation

columns.text: Yahweh wanted to create is own nation, free from the idols/gods. The descendants of Abraham would be His own special nation. So He made a covenant with Israel that He would be their God and they would worship no other gods. 1  2
1 Ezk 20:5-7 2 Exo 20:2-3
Yahweh chose Israel to be His people and told them that He was their God (the most high Elohim) in contrast to the other nations who had the sons of (sons of Elohim - rebels from the heavenly realm).
The law was given for: • the lawless and insubordinate • the ungodly and for sinners • the unholy and profane • murderers of fathers and mothers • manslayers 1
1 1Ti 1:9

Yahweh wanted Israel to be His own special treasure, above all people. A kingdom of priests, a nation set apart (holy) for Him. He wanted to preserve them alive in a world full of nations committing adultery. 1  2
1 Exo 19:5-6 2 Deu 6:24
